layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Dense but optical. Use p-3 or p-4 for table cells to allow breathing room, but keep row heights tight for data density.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Sharp to slightly rounded (rounded-sm). 1px sharp borders for all components.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active elements, shadow-md strictly for elevated states (like inline edit mode or dropdowns).

tabs_navigation.description: Shift away from generic Shadcn pills. Use an elegant, underlined active state.
tabs_navigation.item: pb-3 text-sm font-outfit font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors relative
tabs_navigation.active_item: text-[#002FA7] after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:w-full after:h-0.5 after:bg-[#002FA7]

inline_editable_tables.philosophy: Inline row editing MUST be preserved, absolutely no modal-based CRUD. The row must visually pop out when entering edit mode to maintain focus.
inline_editable_tables.edit_state_row: relative z-10 bg-white ring-1 ring-[#002FA7] shadow-md border-transparent
inline_editable_tables.inputs: w-full h-8 px-2 text-sm border-slate-200 rounded-sm focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#002FA7] focus-visible:border-[#002FA7] transition-all
inline_editable_tables.actions_column: flex items-center justify-end space-x-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity
inline_editable_tables.s_no_column: w-12 text-center text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 select-none

chips_and_pills.general: Inline flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs border whitespace-nowrap
chips_and_pills.dependency_chip: bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200 flex items-center gap-1

budget_workflow_header.layout: Flex container with state chip, summary totals, and action buttons. Sticky top if table is long.
budget_workflow_header.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-4 mb-6 flex justify-between items-center shadow-sm
budget_workflow_header.status_chip: font-outfit font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-xs px-3 py-1 border rounded-sm

stakeholders.inline_add: A permanent 'Add Stakeholder' row at the bottom with dashed border, or a top row that appears when clicking 'Add'.
stakeholders.employee_picker: Use a Shadcn Popover Combobox for selecting internal employees within the inline cell.

plan.task_cell: Bold task name, block-display small optional description below it.
plan.status_dropdown: Instead of text, render a sleek inline select (ghost trigger) that looks like a chip but is clickable.
plan.overdue_highlight: If overdue and not Done, the Timeline cell gets a text-[#FF3B30] class and a small warning icon.
plan.attachments: Show tiny paperclip icon with count. In edit mode, show a dropzone or simple file input.

budget.variance_styling: Tabular nums. If positive (over budget): text-[#FF3B30]. If negative/zero (under/on budget): text-[#34C759].
budget.lock_states: If pending approval, inputs are disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed). If approved, only 'Actual' is an input in edit mode.

micro_interactions.hover: Table rows highlight subtly. Action buttons reveal on hover to reduce visual clutter.
micro_interactions.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out` for input focus rings and row elevations.
micro_interactions.loading: Use skeleton rows matching the exact table structure, not spinners.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: MUST include `data-testid` on all inputs, action buttons, table rows, and tabs (e.g., `data-testid='plan-task-row-3'`, `data-testid='budget-submit-approval'`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #002FA7 and #FF3B30 maintain APCA/WCAG AA contrast against white/slate-50 backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You are editing `.js` files, NOT `.tsx`. Ensure you do not use TypeScript annotations.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the three tabs (Stakeholders, Plan, Budget), remove any modal Dialog components for Add/Edit/Delete.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement inline editing state tracking per row (e.g., `editingRowId` state). Replace static text with Shadcn Inputs/Selects/Comboboxes natively inside the `<td>` when a row is active.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Add an explicit 'S.No' column to Stakeholders and Plan tables. Map index + 1 if needed.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use generic Vercel gradients. Stick to Nyla Air Water brand styling: flat white/slate backgrounds, sharp 1px borders, #002FA7 primary highlights.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use lucide-react for icons (e.g., Edit2, Trash2, Paperclip, AlertCircle).
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not center the app container text. Keep data strictly left-aligned, financials right-aligned.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Use `table-fixed` with exact width classes for action/status columns to prevent layout jumping when switching to edit mode.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Preserve all existing data fields and the Budget approval logic/state machine.
instructions_to_main_agent.10: For components needing transparent backgrounds, do not use `bg-transparent` blindly if content scrolls underneath; use `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm`.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment. Provide distinct :hover and :focus-visible states for every interactive element. Avoid using universal transitions (`transition-all` on root elements). Never use placeholder emojis for icons. Use dense layouts for dashboards but maintain high contrast and clear hierarchy. Add data-testid to everything.
